notes: This is a free app released under the MIT license. The project now lives at github.com/jacek-mar/star-conflict-chat-translator.

changes: Supports the new Star Conflict log folder (AppData\Local\Targem\StarConflict) and switches to it automatically
Clear, short messages when a translation fails, instead of technical errors
Translation pauses when the free daily limit is reached and resumes on its own
Optional email in Settings raises the free daily limit from 5,000 to 50,000 characters
Repeated messages are translated once and reused
Project, user manual and downloads moved to GitHub

welcome_message:
This app helps translate and manage in-game chat messages.
It was created to improve the game experience for players from different countries.
It is still in development and may contain some minor bugs. Released under the MIT license.
The application uses a free translation service (MyMemory) and does not interfere with the game code.
Check your preferences in the Settings tab.
Feel free to share your feedback about this program with me.
New in version 1.4.0:
- support for the new Star Conflict log folder,
- clear messages and an automatic pause when the free daily translation limit is reached,
- optional email in Settings for a 10x higher daily limit,
- project, user manual and downloads moved to GitHub.
